newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, traders focus on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, traders focus on arbitrage.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday with traders focusing on arbitrage chances.
Naphtha edged higher on crude's rally and further U.S. arbitrage interest. Demand fell for heavier grades.
Gasoline rallied sharply as an open arbitrage to the U.S. continued to draw supplies out of NWE, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were a touch softer, down $1 at $117-119 fob ARA. Cargoes were steady.
Gas oil barge trade was again stifled by the IPE delivery standoff while cargo interest shifted to a possible arbitrage to the east. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185
